name: Cole Stanford
source:
Favorite food: The Big Kettleburger™ from The Sunnyside-Up Diner
Favorite horror movie: Suspiria
Worst habit: Tidies up your room when you're not paying attention

A third-year history major at Kettleboro University, and Sage's best friend since childhood. Second cameraman, video editor, and the glue that holds the Haunt Hunters together.

He loves horror movies, but secretly hopes their ghost hunting remains uneventful.

[From [url=https://greensolid.tumblr.com/post/178250636792/introducing-our-next-character-sages-best]Tumblr[/url]]
